title: Undergraduate Academic Calendar 2026/2027
text:
Non-Degree, For-credit Program Requirements
Certificate/Diploma Students
If you wish to take a for-
credit
certificate or diploma
program
, you must apply and be admitted. Some certificate and
diploma programs have specific requirements that must be met in order to be admitted. You can find more information
about these requirements on the program pages here.
Transcripts
from all previous post-secondary studies will be required. If no previous post-secondary education was
completed, high school transcripts will be required.
Applicants interested in pursuing additional studies beyond their certificate or diploma, including degree programs, must
complete a program change form available from Enrolment Services. Students must meet progression requirements, and admission is not guaranteed.
